plan: In a single-round auction with rational bidders, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. Since my private value is $30, I want to maximize potential profit. A good approach is to bid close to, but not exceeding, my value - around $29.9. This strategy minimizes the risk of overpaying while still having a good chance of winning. With values drawn independently and other bidders also being rational, this approach balances winning probability and potential profit.
